title: Precision Regret of Adaptive AIPW Experiments with Bounded Outcomes
banked_reason: The proposed full bounded-class sharp minimax frontier and attaining predictable policy are not delivered: this node remains an open question, while the proved result is only the common-outcome subfamily plus a logarithmic-to-square-root full-class bracket. Independent main validity confirms terminal:laundering as non-delivery, not a refutation.
gap_reasons: The proposed full bounded-class sharp minimax frontier and attaining predictable policy are not delivered: this node remains an open question, while the proved result is only the common-outcome subfamily plus a logarithmic-to-square-root full-class bracket.

On the original full bounded class, only the logarithmic-to-square-root bracket is established. The exact sharp order, a policy attaining it, the centered stability order, and its numerical accuracy transfer remain open.
proof_attempt_summary: Two proposal versions reached D-0.5 ACCEPT at field; two D0 solve rounds strengthened the bounded sign-cycle converse and its intersection-class transfer, while exact common-outcome regret and a full-class logarithmic-to-square-root bracket were derived. All three external lemmas were retrieved, independently checked, and attested; the final math referee passed the components, but the decision referee found the promised sharp full-class frontier and computable attaining policy undelivered. Independent main validity confirmed terminal:laundering for kernel non-delivery (not mathematical refutation), with retry appropriate only for a genuinely new stability proof or legal bounded converse; no formalization or Lean proof was produced.
tldr: The principal solved result is sharp \(\Theta(\log(1+T))\) cumulative AIPW precision regret on the bounded common-outcome subfamily \(\mathcal C_T^{=}\), attained by balanced allocation and a current-feature ridge update. The lower bound covers every admissible predictable policy in the pinned AIPW family and has deterministic witnesses in \(\mathcal C_T^{=}\cap\mathcal M_T^{\mathrm{Chen}}\). On the full bounded class, the established bracket is \(c\log(1+T)\le\Psi_T(d,R,\kappa,v)\le D_0L\sqrt T\); its sharp order and the centered FTRL stability order remain open. The comparison set is a fixed-constant, fixed-radius, intercept-augmented specialization: \(\mathcal C_T\subsetneq\mathcal M_T^{\mathrm{Chen}}\) for \(d=1\), whereas the classes are incomparable for \(d\ge2\). Chen et al.'s stronger converse does not transfer to the bounded class.
gap: Chen et al. studies the identical AIPW precision comparator under fourth moments and prefix regularity. Its Appendix B.1 construction leaves the bounded-support frontier unresolved. Fast raw-HT learning and conditionally stationary centered A2IPW do not determine \(\Psi_T\) on the stated deterministic class.
fill: Open-ended Question 1 demands an explicit minimax rate and computable attaining design on the original class, together with a legal-table lower certificate. Open-ended Question 2 tests one centered selective-feedback route without assuming that it attains the frontier.
